sn25.2:1.8: yo bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddhānusārī …pe…
sn25.2:2.1: ayaṃ vuccati dhammānusārī okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.
sn25.2:2.2: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya,
sn25.2:2.3: abhabboca tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
sn25.2:2.4: yo bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ jānāti passati, ayaṃ vuccati.
